attribute_information.DIM: days in milk when the feed allocation is based on milk yield
attribute_information.dbdryoff: number of days before dry off that milking robot access is reduced
attribute_information.farmID: number used to identify the farm corresponding to the settings recorded
attribute_information.feed1: quantity of feed the cow will receive during the period before dry off
attribute_information.feed2: final quantity of feed the cow is permitted to consume right before going dry
attribute_information.feeddbdryoff1: number of days before the cow goes dry that the quantity of feed is dropped for the second time
attribute_information.feeddbdryoff2: number of days before the cow goes dry that the quantity of feed is dropped for the second time
attribute_information.feeddbdryoff3: number of days before the cow goes dry that the quantity of feed is dropped for the final time
attribute_information.feedmax: maximum feed allocation based on milk yield
attribute_information.feedmin: minimum feed allocation based on milk yield
attribute_information.maxmilkings: maximum number of times that a cow is permitted to visit the robot per day
attribute_information.minmilkings: minimum permitted number of times that a cow can visit a robot per day
attribute_information.yield: based off the predicted average yield of a cow per milking, this setting will let a cow through the robot if she is expected to produce more than a certain quantity of milk

attribute_labels.feeddbdryoff1: days before dry off of first feed reduction
attribute_labels.feeddbdryoff2: days before dry off of second feed reduction
attribute_labels.feeddbdryoff3: days before dry off of third feed reduction

meta.description: This schema represents data collected from 99 dairy farms across Ontario, and indicates settings used in robotic milking systems to reduce robot and feed access as cows are nearing the end of their lactation
meta.name: UNIV6020
